text:
maria chen: kicking off a mid-roll deploy for feature flag `llm-route-v2`. plan: 0% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% over ~30m with telemetry gates. see runbook: https://confluence.redwood/KB/llm-route-v2
kevin li: ack. what's the live rollback criteria? latency + error rate thresholds?
sarah g: yes, SLOs: p95 latency +15% or error spike >1.5x baseline for 5m -> rollback. also quality regen check (eval set A) at 10% step.
release-bot: release note drafted: "llm-route-v2: improved routing for short-context requests; opt-in routing via ff/llm-route-v2" (link: https://release.redwood/notes/2026-03-xx)
maria chen: deploy window: 02:00-04:00 UTC, low traffic. Kevin please watch infra metrics, Sarah watch quality eval. Ops-oncall stand by for fast rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy job 4783 queued by maria chen. image: rwd/llm-route:v2-20260323. Dry-run OK.
kevin li: quick pin on config so we can unpin to v1 if needed?
lucas r: pinned routing-config to v1-fallback in case of emergency. command: `rwdctl config set routing.fallback v1 --pin`
maria chen: starting 2% ramp now. will post when step completes.
deploy-bot: job 4783: applying feature flag llm-route-v2 -> 2% (cohort sampling).
kevin li: seeing small cpu uptick on batchers + slight p99 jitter, p95 stable. sending dashboard snapshot.
sarah g: eval A running against sample. first pass looks neutral. no regression on quality metrics so far.
maria chen: holding at 2% for 10m to validate. monitoring autopruning and kv-cache hit rate.
ops-oncall: alert on ephemeral: error-rate doubled for a single pod (app/worker-3). investigating logs.
kevin li: looking — stack traces show OOM in image rwd/llm-route:v2 on 1 pod. scaling group kicked another replica.
lucas r: hotfix: reduce batch size for v2 route. patch pushed as rwd/llm-route:v2-20260323a. planning a quick canary swap.
maria chen: do not rollback yet. try canary swap to patched image, keep flag at 2%.
deploy-bot: starting canary update: replacing 1 pod with image v2-20260323a.
release-bot: note: changed image for v2 due to unexpected mem pressure. added to release notes.
sarah g: rerun eval A on canary — results look fine. no quality drop.
kevin li: mem stabilizing, OOM gone on patched pod. CPU normalizing. recommend proceed to 10%.
maria chen: ramping to 10% now. schedule: 10% for 10m then evaluate.
deploy-bot: feature flag llm-route-v2 -> 10% applied. cohorts updated.
kevin li: monitoring: p95 +8%, p99 +12%, error-rate baseline. all green within thresholds.
sarah g: eval set A and B. A ok, B shows a 0.6% regression on precision for one prompt slice — not huge but noted. putting on the watchlist.
maria chen: ok proceed to 30% after 10m if no new regressions. ops still standing by.
ops-oncall: adding temporary alert: if error-rate >1.2x baseline for 3m, automatic pause via deploybot.
deploy-bot: autopause rule configured: ff/llm-route-v2 -> pause if error >20% or p95 delta >20% for 3m.
lucas r: can someone update the release-notes snippet with the patched-image callout and rollback instructions? small snippet: `If you need to rollback: rwdctl ff set llm-route-v2 0 && rwdctl config unpin routing.fallback`
maria chen: will update. next check in 8m then decide.
kevin li: seeing a small increase in token-generation latency for long-context flows. p95 long-context +18% at 20% of traffic routed — that's approaching our rollback threshold.
sarah g: quality regressions creeping for long-context prompts in eval B. delta 1.2% worst-slice. still borderline.
maria chen: pausing the ramp at 30% step early (holding at 10% -> keeping current). switching plan: keep at 10% until tomorrow morning, then re-evaluate with added regression tests. marking rollout as "paused" in the sheet.\eops-oncall: acknowledged. (typo intentional to mimic quick slack)
release-bot: rollout status updated: PAUSED at 10% due to performance/quality watch. link: https://release.redwood/status/4783
kevin li: rolling back not necessary right now, but we should prepare a controlled rollback playbook if metrics worsen overnight.
lucas r: prepared a rollback snippet and a canary drain play: `rwdctl ff set llm-route-v2 0 --reason "auto-pause" && kubectl rollout restart deploy/router-v1`
sarah g: add eval regressions to ticket #1234 and tag product.
maria chen: thanks all. will write short postmortem tomorrow if we fail to fully resume. leaving notes in the runbook and release page. cc @ops-oncall for overnight watch. :eyes:
